jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in Hong Kong for 40 years where it employs around 200 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

• Perform name screening/transaction monitoring against applicable policies and standards.

• Perform daily review on automated name screening/transaction monitoring alerts.

• Contribute to audits or inspections that covers AML activities.

• Support the Client Business Compliance - AML team in embedding robust risk awareness throughout Hong Kong Branch.

• Perform any required remedial efforts identified from risk assessment or audit findings.

• Prepare metrics relating to the Client Business Compliance activity.

• Provide administrative and ad-hoc support to the team.

• At least one year of relevant experience in banking/finance/audit

• Proficiency in English and Chinese

• Organized and attentive to details

• Self-motivated

• IT skills and relevant software proficiency

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager
jobs.description:
Your team

The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation.

Pictet’s Group Strategy and Projects team is part of the Group’s Corporate Functions and reports to the Group Senior Managing Partner. It acts as an in-house strategy consulting unit whose purpose is to support the firm and its most senior management in defining and achieving both long-term and annual strategic priorities.

Your role

We regularly seek dynamic and self-driven individuals to be part of a well-established and dynamic team, which has frequent contact with senior management and staff to drive strategic change across our Group.

In this role, you will:

• Lead strategic projects, ensuring the delivery of expected deliverables with a tangible impact. This includes effective problem structuring, robust project design and planning, rigorous problem-solving, ease of collaboration with stakeholders, an entrepreneurial mindset, as well as diligent execution.
• Perform research, conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses, and prepare recommendations for senior management.
• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on these tasks and support them in their organisational and strategic responsibilities.

Your profile

• Master’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Business or a STEM field.
• Solid professional experience, including at least three years experience in a major consulting and strategy firm.
• Experience in the financial and banking industry is a plus.
• Self-driven and autonomous professional, with strong conceptual thinking skills and an entrepreneurial spirit.
• Outstanding analytical problem-solving skills.
• Client-oriented and results-driven, with flexibility.
• Proactive, autonomous, well organised, efficient and able to work under pressure.
• Proven people and influencing skills.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken.
• Discretion and confidentiality.
• Fluent in English. French proficiency a plus. Other language(s) an asset.
• Must be resident in Switzerland.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : SPM/CC/JG

Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

We are seeking to hire a highly motivated and entrepreneurial Software Engineer for our Equities department. Our goal is to build innovative tools that transform complex sustainability data into actionable insights for responsible financial decisions. As an early, high-impact member of the team, you will take ownership of architecting and building these intuitive, end-to-end systems.

Your role

• Designing, building and maintaining end-to-end web applications, including front-end, back-end, and database layers.

• Implementing agentic AI capabilities into content tools and drive adoption of AI workflows and best practices.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to design intuitive high-quality UIs that make complex data easy to understand and navigate.

• Proven experience in building a great product or 7+ years of professional experience.

• Early adopter of agentic engineering practices, with a strong grasp of the current AI ecosystem (frameworks, tooling, and workflows).

• Strong full-stack fundamentals: React, TypeScript/JavaScript on the frontend; Python and REST/GraphQL APIs on the backend; SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Hands-on experience deploying and operating solutions end-to-end (ideally in AWS), including data ingestion, transformation, and serving, with solid practices around testing, versioning, and observability.

• Entrepreneurial drive and a sharp analytical mindset, with the ability to quickly ramp up on new domains, tools, and techniques through self-learning.

• Full ownership of a strategic product from an early stage, shaping its architecture, data flows, and AI capabilities.

Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Transaction Officer - Cash to join our Banking Operations team . The primary responsibility of this role is to process IN/OUT payment transactions efficiently and accurately, ensuring seamless operations across various payment systems and customer categories.

Your role

• Process, invoice, and validate payment orders across systems such as TARGET, SEPA (SCT/SDD), and cash correspondent networks

• Handle transactions for all customer categories, including PWM, PAS FRONT, FPS, and PAM PAI, in all currencies and for all BPAG entities (7 Business Units)

• Manage incoming SWIFT MX and SEPA messages (Pacs.00x & Camt.0xx)

• Reconcile suspense items and monitor investigation files

• Ensure accurate accounting of incoming funds via SWIFT, SEPA, TARGET, and BACS for our customers

• Analyze and process reversals, cheque cashing, and issue requests

• Perform first-level processing of Fircosoft hits

• Manage standing orders, including creation, validation, and closure

• Process SWIFT FreeText eT Broadcast messages

• Enter, correct, verify, and authorize SWIFT messages in the AMH system

• Ensure that risk management is controlled at every stage of operations processing, including during the updating of procedures

• Analyze existing processes to identify productivity gains and apply Agile and Lean working methods

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Minimum Bac +2 or equivalent in Economics

• At least 3 years of experience in a "Custodian Bank / Custody" department

• Proficiency in back-office transfer processes

• Competenze di MS eccellenti, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint. Interessi sugli sviluppi dell'IA.

We are seeking a DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen the reliability and performance of the bank’s strategic application processes through an advanced monitoring and observability framework across both on-premises and cloud environments. Monitoring is designed and implemented in close cooperation with software engineering teams in order to track end-to-end application chains. Industrialize application and business‑process deployments by designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure production releases and a stable IT production environment.. Participation in a periodic 24/7 on-call shift is required.

Your role

• Provide support to operations teams. Lead post-incident reviews, including Root Cause Analysis and post-mortems. Define and track preventive action plans.

• Collaborate with business and technical teams to align system reliability with operational needs and produce clear operational documentation.

• Industrialize and standardize the deployment of applications and business processes through automated CI/CD pipelines.

• Design, implement and maintain monitoring and observability solutions for business processes, including dashboards, reliability indicators, alerting and end-to-end flow traceability, with advanced use of the Grafana Observability Stack across on-premises systems and cloud services.

• Analyze business-process performance and recommend improvements.

• Integrate new processing tasks into the production schedule and/or optimize existing ones.

• Configure and implement data transfers with external partners, ensuring reliability, traceability and end-to-end monitoring.

• Contribute to the cloud strategy, including deployments, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

• Automate recurring tasks through scripts, workflows and tooling in collaboration with development and operations teams

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and data-protection requirements.

• Fluent in french and english

• Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar role, ideally within a banking environment or fund administration

• Strong expertise in monitoring and observability tools, as well as distributed tracing concepts (Grafana, Dynatrace, Jaeger).

• Good knowledge of cloud environments from major providers (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), with a sound understanding of IaaS, PaaS and SaaS service models.

Vous rejoindrez le Risk & Compliance Data Office, qui a pour objectif d'être le partenaire de confiance et d'innovation pour la communauté Risk & Compliance du Groupe. L'unité permet une prise de décision éclairée et une gestion proactive des risques grâce à une technologie de pointe, à des plates-formes évolutives et à des données de haute qualité. Sa mission est d'offrir des solutions de données fiables, bien gérées et tournées vers l'avenir qui répondent à des exigences réglementaires changeantes, de favoriser des connaissances fondées sur les données et de permettre la prise de décisions stratégiques confiantes.

Cette position se concentrera d'abord plus fortement sur l'ingénierie des données, en soutenant l'évolution des plateformes de données de risque et de conformité et la migration des capacités de données et d'analyse vers Snowflake. Comme pour tous les ingénieurs en analyse, le rôle devrait évoluer au fil du temps pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels et aux priorités de l'équipe.

Votre rôle

• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires des risques, les agents de conformité et les dirigeants pour traduire les objectifs stratégiques et les exigences réglementaires en produits de données robustes et de haute qualité, y compris les analyses, les tableaux de bord et les solutions de rapport.
• En tant que conseiller en données de confiance auprès des intervenants, fournir des conseils et du soutien pour assurer une utilisation efficace de l'analyse et des rapports, tout en traduisant les exigences opérationnelles ambiguës en spécifications techniques claires et réalisables.
• S'approprier de bout en bout les thèmes d'affaires en prenant des initiatives proactives qui harmonisent les solutions de données avec les besoins de l'entreprise et fournissent une valeur mesurable, de la source des données à la vision de la direction.
• Développer l'architecture et gérer la chaîne de valeur de bout en bout pour les verticales de données de risque et de conformité, en veillant à ce que les analyses et les rapports qui en résultent puissent être utilisés dans l'ensemble du Groupe.
• Conception et déploiement de mesures précises, prêtes à l'exécution et de tableaux de bord interactifs qui résistent à l'examen réglementaire et soutiennent la posture de risque stratégique du Groupe.
• Favoriser la modernisation et la rationalisation de la logique commerciale existante en migrant et en automatisant des solutions dans des architectures de données modernes et des plateformes cloud, ainsi que la mise en œuvre d'approches innovantes, telles que l'IA, les agents intelligents et l'automatisation, pour améliorer les capacités d'analyse.
• Assurer une qualité et un contrôle rigoureux des données conformément au cadre de gouvernance des données du Groupe afin de préserver l'intégrité des données sur les risques et la conformité critiques pour la mission.
• Gérer de façon autonome et résiliente les demandes ponctuelles et les rapports réglementaires complexes en volume élevé.
• Collaboration proactive avec les intervenants pour anticiper leurs besoins, cerner les possibilités d'améliorations fondées sur les données et promouvoir les pratiques exemplaires en matière d'analyse et de rapport.
• Contribuer aux initiatives interfonctionnelles visant à harmoniser la communauté des risques et de la conformité et le Groupe sur la gouvernance des données, la stratégie en matière de données, la littératie des données et les pratiques exemplaires.

Votre profil

• Maîtrise en analyse des données, informatique, finance, génie ou un domaine connexe. Les certifications avancées (p. ex. FRM ou FCA) seraient un plus.

• Compétences de niveau expert en SQL et Python, y compris la conception, la maintenance et l'orchestration de flux de travail ETL/ELT modernes.
• L'expérience avec Snowflake et les plateformes de données modernes basées sur le cloud serait un atout important.
• Expérience de l'information commerciale et des plateformes de rapport comme Tableau, Power BI ou équivalent.
• La connaissance de la gestion des risques, de la conformité, des opérations bancaires et/ou des rapports réglementaires serait un avantage.
• Entrepreneuriel et attitude «can‐do» avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et collaborative dans un environnement matriciel à rythme rapide.
• Des compétences solides en communication, résolution de problèmes, organisation, relations interpersonnelles et gestion de projets.
